description: This file defines utility methods for creating factory functions that instantiate objects using the dependency injection system via IServiceProvider. It provides methods to generate factories with varying numbers of parameters, utilizing ActivatorUtilities.CreateFactory to facilitate object creation within the Orleans Runtime framework.

classes.name: FactoryUtility
classes.description: A static internal utility class providing factory creation methods for different constructor signatures.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a factory returning a new instance of type TInstance using the provided IServiceProvider; applicable for parameterless constructors.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a factory returning a new instance of type TInstance that accepts one parameter of type TParam1, using the provided IServiceProvider.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a factory returning a new instance of type TInstance that accepts two parameters of types TParam1 and TParam2, respectively.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a factory returning a new instance of type TInstance that accepts three parameters of types TParam1, TParam2, and TParam3, respectively.
